publish.title: Publish Dataset
publish.sub: Complete the steps below to make your dataset available.

step_heads.p: Upload your dataset. We detect columns, types, and quality automatically.
Good metadata makes your data discoverable and reusable by the community.
Confirm column types and descriptions — this raises the usability score.
Choose how the community can reuse your data.
Review everything before submitting for DataRural curation.
